reply.text:
That one's not mine to answer, and it's not something to do safely at home. Dosing steroids, microdose or otherwise, is a conversation for a doctor, who can look at your bloodwork and health history and tell you what the risks are for you. I won't give amounts or schedules.

What I can do is help you get the most out of the natural side: progressive overload, enough protein, sleep, and a program built around your schedule. If you want, I can build you a block to chase more strength or muscle.
